review_evidence: Asymptotics.lean: defines Complexity.BigO and Complexity.LittleO over Mathlib IsBigO/IsLittleO with scoped infix notation, and proves 36 declarations including BigO.refl, BigO.trans, BigO.mul, BigO.pow, LittleO.trans_bigO, BigO.pow_polynomial_bound, BigO.natSize_of_pow.
TimeConstructible.lean: def TimeConstructible (AB Definition 1.12) with theorems TimeConstructible.le_apply, TimeConstructible.pos, TimeConstructible.computable.

Circuits.lean: `module` plus 73 public imports and one private import (Circuits.Internal.Bridge); long docstring describing the Circuit B N M G model and main results (functional completeness, Shannon lower bound shannon_lower_bound_circuit, Schnorr XOR bound, Barrington, Valiant depth reduction).
Classes.lean: `module` plus about 90 imports of class modules (P, NP, PH, PPoly, containments such as PSPACESubsetIP) and a docstring on complexity classes.
DescriptiveComplexity.lean: `module` plus 37 imports and a long docstring naming Sentence.orderIndependent (Immerman Prop 1.16), FODefinable.queryFamily_mem_AC0, and the ESO subset NP result.

Algebraic.lean, BooleanAnalysis.lean, Encoding.lean, Interop.lean, Languages.lean, Metacomplexity.lean, Models.lean, SAT.lean: `module` plus public import lists and docstrings describing the subtheories (e.g. Interop names mem_DSPACE_zero_of_isRegular, mem_L_of_isRegular, mem_P_of_isRegular; SAT describes CNF.eval, 3SAT NP-completeness, Cook-Levin).
No file meets the FILTER-004 bar: 2 files hold declarations and proofs, and 11 aggregation files are navigation modules that FILTER-007 keeps primary-eligible.
summary: Read all 13 files in Complexitylib/ (top-level modules). 2 files hold declarations: Asymptotics.lean (36 def/theorem declarations: BigO, LittleO, scoped =O/=o notation, and lemmas such as BigO.trans, BigO.pow, BigO.natSize_of_pow, polynomial_eval_mono_nat) and TimeConstructible.lean (def TimeConstructible plus theorems le_apply, pos, computable). The other 11 files are Lean `module` aggregation files: public import lists followed by substantial module docstrings that name headline results and declarations (e.g. shannon_lower_bound_circuit, Sentence.orderIndependent, mem_P_of_isRegular, Cook-Levin, Sipser-Lautemann). Under FILTER-007 these stay primary-eligible because no verified auxiliary navigation channel exists, and the `module` command and docstrings take them outside a pure-import class. All 13 files are retained.
